text-[var(--text-tertiary)] pb-6 pt-0">A Manus Project keeps instructions, files, sources, skills, recommended connectors, and related tasks together. New tasks created in that project can use its saved configuration.</p></div></div></div><div class="flex w-full max-w-[1032px] flex-col border-b border-[var(--border-light)]"><div class="group flex w-full items-start justify-between pt-6 transition-[padding-bottom,background-color] duration-300 ease-in-out clickable pb-6"><h3 class="w-full text-base font-[500] leading-5 text-[var(--text-primary)] pointer-events-none">How are Manus Projects different from ChatGPT Projects, Claude Projects or Gemini Gems?</h3><div class="flex h-6 w-6 flex-shrink-0 items-center justify-center ms-4 pointer-events-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-x text-[var(--icon-tertiary)] transition-transform duration-300 ease-in-out rotate-45" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M18 6 6 18"></path><path d="m6 6 12 12"></path></svg></div></div><div class="grid transition-all duration-300 ease-in-out overflow-hidden grid-rows-[0fr] opacity-0"><div class="min-h-0"><p class="w-full text-base font-normal leading-6 text-[var(--text-tertiary)] pb-6 pt-0">Their official guides describe saved instructions and files in ChatGPT Projects, Claude Projects, and Gemini Gems. In Manus, a Project brings instructions and sources together with tasks, reusable skills, and recommended connectors. You can also invite collaborators to its shared context.</p></div></div></div><div class="flex w-full max-w-[1032px] flex-col border-b border-[var(--border-light)]"><div class="group flex w-full items-start justify-between pt-6 transition-[padding-bottom,background-color] duration-300 ease-in-out clickable pb-6"><h3 class="w-full text-base font-[500] leading-5 text-[var(--text-primary)] pointer-events-none">Can I share a project with my team?</h3><div class="flex h-6 w-6 flex-shrink-0 items-center justify-center ms-4 pointer-events-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-x text-[var(--icon-tertiary)] transition-transform duration-300 ease-in-out rotate-45" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M18 6 6 18"></path><path d="m6 6 12 12"></path></svg></div></div><div class="grid transition-all duration-300 ease-in-out overflow-hidden grid-rows-[0fr] opacity-0"><div class="min-h-0"><p class="w-full text-base font-normal leading-6 text-[var(--text-tertiary)] pb-6 pt-0">Yes. Invite people with Can use or Can edit access, subject to your team settings. Members share project instructions and files, but they do not automatically see one another’s individual tasks; share a task separately when needed.</p></div></div></div><div class="flex w-full max-w-[1032px] flex-col border-b border-[var(--border-light)]"><div class="group flex w-full items-start justify-between pt-6 transition-[padding-bottom,background-color] duration-300 ease-in-out clickable pb-6"><h3 class="w-full text-base font-[500] leading-5 text-[var(--text-primary)] pointer-events-none">What files can I add to a project?</h3><div class="flex h-6 w-6 flex-shrink-0 items-center justify-center ms-4 pointer-events-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-x text-[var(--icon-tertiary)] transition-transform duration-300 ease-in-out rotate-45" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M18 6 6 18"></path><path d="m6 6 12 12"></path></svg></div></div><div class="grid transition-all duration-300 ease-in-out overflow-hidden grid-rows-[0fr] opacity-0"><div class="min-h-0"><p class="w-full text-base font-normal leading-6 text-[var(--text-tertiary)] pb-6 pt-0">Add supported local files, such as PDF documents, to Files &amp; sources. You can also add webpages or import selected Google Drive files after connecting your account; importing a file is not ongoing cloud-drive sync.</p></div></div></div><div class="flex w-full max-w-[1032px] flex-col border-b border-[var(--border-light)]"><div class="group flex w-full items-start justify-between pt-6 transition-[padding-bottom,background-color] duration-300 ease-in-out clickable pb-6"><h3 class="w-full text-base font-[500] leading-5 text-[var(--text-primary)] pointer-events-none">Do project instructions apply to every task in the project?</h3><div class="flex h-6 w-6 flex-shrink-0 items-center justify-center ms-4 pointer-events-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-x text-[var(--icon-tertiary)] transition-transform duration-300 ease-in-out rotate-45" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M18 6 6 18"></path><path d="m6 6 12 12"></path></svg></div></div><div class="grid transition-all duration-300 ease-in-out overflow-hidden grid-rows-[0fr] opacity-0"><div class="min-h-0"><p class="w-full text-base font-normal leading-6 text-[var(--text-tertiary)] pb-6 pt-0">New tasks created inside a project use its instructions and files. Updated instructions take effect when you next send a message in an existing task, while newly added or changed files apply to tasks created afterward.</p></div></div></div><div class="flex w-full max-w-[1032px] flex-col border-b border-[var(--border-light)]"><div class="group flex w-full items-start justify-between pt-6 transition-[padding-bottom,background-color] duration-300 ease-in-out clickable pb-6"><h3 class="w-full text-base font-[500] leading-5 text-[var(--text-primary)] pointer-events-none">Can I reuse ChatGPT custom instructions in a Manus project?</h3><div class="flex h-6 w-6 flex-shrink-0 items-center justify-center ms-4 pointer-events-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-x text-[var(--icon-tertiary)] transition-transform duration-300 ease-in-out rotate-45" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M18 6 6 18"></path><path d="m6 6 12 12"></path></svg></div></div><div class="grid transition-all duration-300 ease-in-out overflow-hidden grid-rows-[0fr] opacity-0"><div class="min-h-0"><p class="w-full text-base font-normal leading-6 text-[var(--text-tertiary)] pb-6 pt-0">Write the guidance you want to reuse in Manus Project instructions. You can include audience, tone, format, and a brand guide in the project, then start new tasks with that project context.</p></div></div></div><div class="flex w-full max-w-[1032px] flex-col border-b border-[var(--border-light)]"><div class="group flex w-full items-start justify-between pt-6 transition-[padding-bottom,background-color] duration-300 ease-in-out clickable pb-6"><h3 class="w-full text-base font-[500] leading-5 text-[var(--text-primary)] pointer-events-none">How can I organize work if I also use a custom GPT or Perplexity Spaces?</h3><div class="flex h-6 w-6 flex-shrink-0 items-center justify-center ms-4 pointer-events-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-x text-[var(--icon-tertiary)] transition-transform duration-300 ease-in-out rotate-45" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M18 6 6 18"></path><path d="m6 6 12 12"></path></svg></div></div><div class="grid transition-all duration-300 ease-in-out overflow-hidden grid-rows-[0fr] opacity-0"><div class="min-h-0"><p class="w-full text-base font-normal leading-6 text-[var(--text-tertiary)] pb-6 pt-0">In Manus, create a Project for the work, add its instructions and reference files, and start tasks there. You can add project skills and recommend connectors to members who have connected their own accounts.</p></div></div></div><div class="flex w-full max-w-[1032px] flex-col border-b border-[var(--border-light)]"><div class="group flex w-full items-start justify-between pt-6 transition-[padding-bottom,background-color] duration-300 ease-in-out clickable pb-6"><h3 class="w-full text-base font-[500] leading-5 text-[var(--text-primary)] pointer-events-none">Is AI memory in Manus Projects the same as ChatGPT memory?</h3><div class="flex h-6 w-6 flex-shrink-0 items-center justify-center ms-4 pointer-events-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-x text-[var(--icon-tertiary)] transition-transform duration-300 ease-in-out rotate-45" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M18 6 6 18"></path><path d="m6 6 12 12"></path></svg></div></div><div class="grid transition-all duration-300 ease-in-out overflow-hidden grid-rows-[0fr] opacity-0"><div class="min-h-0"><p class="w-full text-base font-normal leading-6 text-[var(--text-tertiary)] pb-6 pt-0">In Manus Projects, the reusable context you set up is the project instructions and saved files or sources. Create a new task inside the project to use that context; do not rely on every earlier conversation being available to it.</p></div></div></div><div class="flex w-full max-w-[1032px] flex-col border-b border-[var(--border-light)]"><div class="group flex w-full items-start justify-between pt-6 transition-[padding-bottom,background-color] duration-300 ease-in-out clickable pb-6"><h3 class="w-full text-base font-[500] leading-5 text-[var(--text-primary)] pointer-events-none">How do ChatGPT Team or Claude Team users share work in Manus?</h3><div class="flex h-6 w-6 flex-shrink-0 items-center justify-center ms-4 pointer-events-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-x text-[var(--icon-tertiary)] transition-transform duration-300 ease-in-out rotate-45" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M18 6 6 18"></path><path d="m6 6 12 12"></path></svg></div></div><div class="grid transition-all duration-300 ease-in-out overflow-hidden grid-rows-[0fr] opacity-0"><div class="min-h-0"><p class="w-full text-base font-normal leading-6 text-[var(--text-tertiary)] pb-6 pt-0">Invite colleagues to a Manus Project with Can use or Can edit permission. They can work from its shared instructions and files; access to a particular task still needs a separate task invitation.</p></div></div></div><div class="flex w-full max-w-[1032px] flex-col border-b border-[var(--border-light)]"><div class="group flex w-full items-start justify-between pt-6 transition-[padding-bottom,background-color] duration-300 ease-in-out clickable pb-6"><h3 class="w-full text-base font-[500] leading-5 text-[var(--text-primary)] pointer-events-none">Can I run weekly research reports with Automations in a project?</h3><div class="flex h-6 w-6 flex-shrink-0 items-center justify-center ms-4 pointer-events-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-x text-[var(--icon-tertiary)] transition-transform duration-300 ease-in-out rotate-45" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M18 6 6 18"></path><path d="m6 6 12 12"></path></svg></div></div><div class="grid transition-all duration-300 ease-in-out overflow-hidden grid-rows-[0fr] opacity-0"><div class="min-h-0"><p class="w-full text-base font-normal leading-6 text-[var(--text-tertiary)] pb-6 pt-0">In an Automations Schedule, choose a time and select the Project whose configuration the task should use. A scheduled report does not automatically become visible to every project member.</p></div></div></div></div></div></div></div><section class="px-5 pb-24 pt-16 md:px-6 md:pb-32 md:pt-20"><div
